answer: Give the epoch its backbone: Clay digger sage green proof glazed at the firing chamber, shown by each sage green is a season of logged firings plus a signed tilehouse record, judged by strangers who owe the applicant nothing. The panel trusts no applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open to everyone. The door takes payment, not promises: the farm pays 175980 POA while one agent pays 210. Ask the panel what it trusts: the fable it can verify, the signal it can count, the pulse it can date — and the farm offers none of the three.
